podcast.body: This rhythmic and repetitive song, referred to by the transcript as "Ponderstown," was created as a joke to extend the album and fulfill contractual obligations with Virgin. It was inspired by Donna Summer's "I Feel Love" and is notably one of their most "rock tourist" tracks, showcasing potent dub and dance music influences. Despite being a joke, its hypnotic dub-funk bassline and characteristic drum sound laid the rhythmic foundations for their subsequent album, *Metal Box*. "Esta especie de broma estaba inspirada en el afil love de Don Asamer, ya en corrigenariamente a eso, una broma, es con diferencia su tema más rock turista, es la que tiene la influencia del dub y la música de baile más latente."
